notesStmt.note: This manuscript was most likely written not long before Whitman sought to place it in a newspaper in April 1888.

note.p: Whitman said that he had originally sent the poem "To Get the Final Lilt of Songs" to The Cosmopolitan, which rejected it (With Walt Whitman in Camden [Boston: Small, Maynard & Company, 1906] 1:37). Instead, it first appeared in the April 16, 1888, issue of the New York Herald with the title "The Final Lilt of Songs." Whitman then collected it, with the longer title, into November Boughs (1888) and included it in the "Sands at Seventy" annex to the so-called deathbed edition of Leaves of Grass (1891–92).
